// Owned inspection-only codec fixture. It never alters a selected original.
use std::{
    env, fs,
    path::PathBuf,
    thread,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

fn main() {
    let arguments = env::args().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if arguments
        .first()
        .is_some_and(|argument| argument == "-help")
    {
        println!("owned chdman extractcd verify fixture");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    assert_eq!(arguments.first().map(String::as_str), Some("extractcd"));
    let argument =
        |name: &str| PathBuf::from(&arguments.windows(2).find(|pair| pair[0] == name).unwrap()[1]);
    let input = argument("-i");
    let cue = argument("-o");
    let bin = argument("-ob");
    let controls = env::current_exe().unwrap().parent().unwrap().to_path_buf();
    let mode = fs::read_to_string(controls.join("mode")).unwrap();
    let bytes = fs::read(&input).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        controls.join("actual-init-id"),
        std::process::id().to_string(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(controls.join("snapshot"), &bytes).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        &cue,
        format!(
            "FILE \"{}\" BINARY\n TRACK 01 MODE2/2352\n INDEX 01 00:00:00\n",
            bin.file_name().unwrap().to_str().unwrap()
        ),
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(
        &bin,
        if bytes[100] >= 4 {
            b"changed psx track".as_slice()
        } else {
            b"owned psx track".as_slice()
        },
    )
    .unwrap();
    if mode == "failure" {
        std::process::exit(7);
    }
    if mode == "held" || (mode == "held-second" && bytes[100] == 1) {
        fs::write(
            controls.join("ready"),
            b"snapshot and output exist; decoder still held",
        )
        .unwrap();
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
        while !controls.join("release").exists() {
            assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "owned fixture release missing");
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
        }
    }
}
